Fixed: context.go `Scheme()` now validates each forwarded header value (case-insensitive "http"/"https") and skips invalid ones, falling through to X-Forwarded-Protocol → X-Forwarded-Ssl → X-Url-Scheme → "http". Verified: go build/vet clean, full `go test ./...` passes, and a throwaway reproduction of the three named tests passes (invalid X-Forwarded-Proto + Protocol=https → "https"; all invalid → "http").
Got it — sixth bug: middleware/compress.go gzip with an empty body. Investigating; ETA ~20 minutes.

Fixed: bind.go `bindData` map branch was inserting `v[0]` (a string) for every map type, panicking for `map[string][]string`, and never allocating a nil map. Now it handles string keys, allocates nil maps, binds full slices for `map[string][]string`, and keeps `map[string]string`/`interface{}` behaviour. Verified: full `go test ./...` passes, and a throwaway reproduction of `TestDefaultBinder_bindDataToMap/ok,_bind_to_map[string][]string` passes.

Fixed: middleware/proxy.go — `roundRobinBalancer.Next` divided by zero and `randomBalancer.Next` called Intn(0) when the balancer had no targets (panic), and the proxy dereferenced a nil target. Now both balancers return nil for empty target lists and the middleware returns 503 Service Unavailable instead of panicking. Verified: `go build`, `go vet`, and `go test ./middleware/ -run TestProxy` all pass, and a throwaway TestProxyBalancerWithNoTargets passes (fails with a divide-by-zero panic on the original code).
